connector.name: Vidnotes
connector.registryDescription: Turn any video into transcripts, summaries, chapters, and comparisons for your AI agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the karniej account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VIDNOTES_API_KEY

env.name: VIDNOTES_API_URL
env.description: VidNotes API base URL. Defaults to https://api.vidnotes.app.
